name: @payswap/best-execution
description: The venue-agnostic best-execution core (Work Order P4-W2-002): execution venues register as capability packs behind the neutral ExecutionVenue port; the core evaluates the NET EXECUTABLE ECONOMIC OUTCOME (output, fees, gas, bridge/FX cost, slippage, liquidity impact, failure/retry risk, time/finality, health, policy, security — every dimension an explicit typed input, no hidden constants) through exact integer/rational arithmetic, carries full route provenance (which venues quoted, at what freshness, through which observation), drives every candidate route through the onchain-security prepare/simulate/diff/gate stages (a security BLOCK kills a route), invalidates stale routes deterministically (mandatory quote/observation freshness), and admits the quote→executed transition ONLY through a real execution observation (finality CANDIDATE or UNKNOWN — never assumed final). Provider-native optimization remains an incumbent baseline (INV-C08/rule 20): the core never hard-codes a venue and never structurally advantages composition.
